items.title: Tre Lamb: Tulsa must 'learn how to win' close games
items.summary: Tre Lamb says Tulsa must learn how to win close games after its heartbreaking loss to Army. The Hurricane turns to the bye week to regroup.

items.title: Baylor Hayes takes responsibility as Tulsa searches for answers after Army loss
items.summary: Tulsa QB Baylor Hayes took responsibility for the Golden Hurricane's late mistakes after the heartbreaking 38-35 loss to Army.

items.title: Football’s Start Time and Network Announced for Tulane
items.summary: The television network and kickoff time for Tulsa's football game at Tulane has been announced by the American Conference.

items.title: Tulsa Hurricane Coaches Show Airs Tonight Live from Elgin Park
items.summary: The Tulsa Football Coaches Show, presented by Western Sun Federal Credit Union, featuring Head Coach Tre Lamb, airs live tonight, Monday, Oct. 26, at its new start time of 6 p.m. from Elgin Park in downtown Tulsa.

items.title: Tulsa blows late lead in gut-wrenching loss to Army
items.summary: Tulsa blew a late lead in a heartbreaking 38-35 loss to Army after a missed field goal, blocked punt and last-second kick doomed the Golden Hurricane.

items.title: Tulsa Falls to Army on Last Second Field Goal, 38-35
items.summary: Tulsa fell to Army, 38-35, on a last second field goal on Friday night at H.A. Chapman Stadium. Tulsa scored 21 unanswered points across three drives in the second half to go from down 28-14 to ahead 35-28, but the push was not enough.

items.title: Tre Lamb explains why option offenses challenge Tulsa
items.summary: Tre Lamb explains how option offenses neutralize Tulsa's defensive line, limit possessions and make patience and 4th-down execution critical.

items.title: Tulsa vs. Army: Can the Golden Hurricane contain Cale Hellums?
items.summary: Tulsa faces Army and quarterback Cale Hellums Friday night. Can the Golden Hurricane contain the nation's top rushing attack and pull off a key win?

items.title: Black Knights present significant challenges for Tulsa
items.summary: Tulsa will face a huge test against Army on Friday night. See how the Golden Hurricane plan to attack the Black Knights on both sides of the ball.

items.title: Tre Lamb strongly supports a 24-Team College Football Playoff
items.summary: Tulsa football coach Tre Lamb supports a proposed 24-team College Football Playoff, citing greater parity and more opportunities.

items.title: Tulsa Welcomes Army to H.A. Chapman Stadium Friday Night
items.summary: Tulsa hosts Army on Friday, Oct. 23, seeking its second consecutive victory over the Black Knights.

items.title: Lamb encouraged by Tulsa's progress as TU prepares for Army
items.summary: Tre Lamb breaks down Tulsa's defensive turnaround against Rice and praises the offensive line's depth and development.

items.title: Concert and Tailgate Experience Set for Army
items.summary: Tulsa fans can begin Friday's football festivities at Chapman Commons, where the Golden Hurricane Tailgate will feature live music, food, drinks and activities for fans of all ages.

items.title: WATCH: Tre Lamb Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: Tulsa Head Football Coach Tre Lamb met with the media Monday as the Golden Hurricane prepares to return home for an American Conference matchup against Army.

items.title: Tulsa can beat Army - if its defense is ready from the opening kickoff
items.summary: Tulsa faces Army after two straight games against option offenses. The Hurricane have the film and experience. Now they must get the plan right.

items.title: Tulsa dominates second half to beat Rice and end losing streak
items.summary: Tulsa scored 31 straight points to rally past Rice 38-17, snapping a three-game losing streak behind Baylor Hayes and a dominant second-half defensive effort.

items.title: Tulsa Takes Down Rice for Conference Road Win
items.summary: Tulsa Football defeated the Rice Owls, 38-17 on Saturday afternoon at First Community Stadium. This was the sixth straight victory for TU over Rice in Houston and snapped a three-game losing streak for TU.

items.title: Tulsa needs to rediscover its early-season form at Rice
items.summary: Tulsa visits Rice needing a win to regain confidence after two heartbreaking losses. Tre Lamb’s Golden Hurricane look to get back on track.

items.title: Tulsa offense is finding its rhythm
items.summary: Tre Lamb says Tulsa's offense is trending upward, praising QB Baylor Hayes and the Hurricane's playmaking receivers as TU seeks a turnaround.

items.title: Tulsa Set for Saturday Conference Clash at Rice
items.summary: Tulsa continues American Conference play at Rice on Saturday, Oct. 17, with kickoff scheduled for 3:30 p.m. CT on ESPN+.

items.title: Tre Lamb: Tulsa is 'doing a lot of things right'
items.summary: Tre Lamb says there's no panic at Tulsa, as the Hurricane focuses on positives in hopes of putting together a complete game at Rice.

items.title: Tulsa suffers 34-26 loss at Navy
items.summary: Tulsa collapsed at the end of each half, resulting in a 34-26 loss at Navy.

items.title: Tulsa Falls to Navy
items.summary: The Tulsa Golden Hurricane came up short on Saturday afternoon as they were defeated by Navy, 34-26.

items.title: Tulsa at Navy: Can the Hurricane get its season back on track?
items.summary: Tulsa visits Navy in a critical American Conference matchup, with the Golden Hurricane needing a win to keep their 2026 championship hopes alive.
